name: Holiday Parties & Company Celebrations
shortDescription: Company holiday parties, year-end dinners, client celebrations, and team gatherings with private dining, patio, and full-venue options for 20 to 180 guests in Little Italy.

seoTitle: Holiday Party Venue San Diego | Company Celebrations | Coco Maya
seoDescription: Plan a company holiday party or year-end celebration at Coco Maya in Little Italy, San Diego. Private dining, patio, custom menus, and full-venue options.
intro: Coco Maya's holiday-party program is built for companies that want a year-end gathering to feel like a night out in San Diego rather than another hotel or conference-room function. Groups can plan a seated dinner, cocktail-style celebration, client event, or a larger company party around the size and purpose of the gathering.

Private-event configurations range from approximately 20 guests to full-venue events of up to 180, with private dining, patio, and larger venue options available depending on the format. The team can coordinate custom food and beverage service, dietary needs, timing, seating, decor or vendor requirements, and the flow of the evening.

For business groups that need more structure, Coco Maya's corporate-event capabilities include centralized billing and itemized invoices, daytime availability, Wi-Fi, and basic AV support in the private dining room when arranged in advance. That makes the same venue workable for a leadership dinner, client appreciation event, awards gathering, or full-company holiday celebration.

highlights.detail: Coco Maya is open daily, creating options for holiday brunches, lunches, afternoon gatherings, happy-hour events, and traditional evening celebrations.

faqs.question: Can Coco Maya host a company holiday party in San Diego?
faqs.answer: Yes. Coco Maya hosts company holiday parties, year-end dinners, team celebrations, and client gatherings in Little Italy, with private dining, patio, and larger venue options based on the size and format of the event.

faqs.question: How many guests can Coco Maya accommodate for a holiday party?
faqs.answer: Private-event configurations can accommodate groups from approximately 20 guests up to 180 guests for a full-venue event. The best space depends on your headcount, service style, and preferred setup.

faqs.question: Can we host a holiday dinner instead of a cocktail-style party?
faqs.answer: Yes. Holiday events can be planned around a seated dinner, a more social food-and-drink format, or a combination of both. Share the experience you want when you inquire so the team can recommend the right setup.

faqs.question: Can Coco Maya accommodate dietary restrictions for a company event?
faqs.answer: Yes. Dietary needs can be considered when planning the event menu. Include any known requirements with your inquiry so they can be incorporated into the proposal and menu planning.

faqs.question: How far in advance should we inquire about a holiday party?
faqs.answer: Earlier is better for preferred November and December dates, especially for larger groups and weekend events. Availability varies, so send your date and expected headcount as soon as your planning window is established.

faqs.question: Can Coco Maya handle company billing for a holiday party?
faqs.answer: Yes. Corporate events can use centralized billing and itemized invoices, which can simplify expense reporting and reimbursement for company-hosted events.

faqs.question: Can we include remarks or a presentation during the event?
faqs.answer: Yes. Basic AV support is available in the private dining room when requirements are confirmed in advance. Share presentation, timing, and equipment needs during planning so service and AV can be coordinated together.
